detail.longDescription: i was using Termius, but it ate all my ram, lagged, and charged 20 bucks for the team plan. so (being impressed by how fast Zed felt) i tried to make an alternative with GPUI. me and my friends have used it for some time and now i want to show it to other people. i tried to make the design look like Zed because i really like it, but i'm not sure it turned out well. would love to hear what you think. it's open-source, mostly built with ai but it doesn't eat my ram and isn't written in electron. local-first (sync and teams are optional). the api is not open source, but if people start using the app, i'll add a self-hosted version. git: https://github.com/mousEHEHE/flint-gpui mac and windows: https://flint.mouse.pw
